$comment: A blank rules profile. Every value is zero, empty or false on purpose: ForceSignal ships no
rules numbers, so this is a form to fill in from your own rulebook and record cards, not a
starting suggestion. Import it in the app under Rules profile, or fill it in here and import
the file. A section your table does not use can be left at zero.
beamDamage, pointDefenseKills and turnaround are tables: list only the die faces that do
something. A face you leave out scores nothing, shoots nothing down, and - for turnaround -
leaves the group flyable and ready next turn.
thresholdRows is either FixedRows or ByShipClass.
